subject: Mythology
title: Tyr: The God Who Sacrificed His Hand
description: A fast breakdown of Tyr: The God Who Sacrificed His Hand for builders.

hook.text: Tyr was the god of justice and the bravest of all the Aesir, but he had only one hand.

buildup.text: The gods needed to bind the monstrous wolf Fenrir with a magical ribbon before he grew too powerful.

discovery.text: Fenrir agreed to be bound only if a god placed a hand in his mouth as a pledge of good faith.

twist.text: Tyr volunteered. When Fenrir realized the ribbon could not be broken, he bit off Tyr's hand in rage.

climax.text: Tyr's sacrifice kept the world safe. Tuesday — Tyr's Day — is named in honor of his courage.

punchline.text: True bravery cost him a hand, and the world gained a day.

quiz.question: Why did Fenrir bite off Tyr's hand?
options: Tyr tried to kill Fenrir in battle
Fenrir realized the binding ribbon could not be broken
Tyr insulted Fenrir during a feast
